task: SimBA-style behavior classification from pose-derived features
primary_method: Supervised classification with engineered spatial/kinematic features from tracked keypoints
named_commitments: Pose-derived frame-level feature tables as input
Aligned behavior labels (Attack, Sniffing) as supervised targets
Supervised classifiers (Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, Logistic Regression)
Quantitative evaluation reports with accuracy, precision, recall, F1, ROC AUC, PR AUC
Transparent and auditable behavior classification evidence
related_work_key_insights: MARS (Segalin et al., 2021): gradient-boosted trees on engineered features for social behavior classification
DeepEthogram (Bohnslav et al., 2021): CNN-based classification from raw pixels as alternative approach
SimBA (Nilsson et al., 2020): original pipeline combining pose estimation with supervised classification
